title: Fable 5.2 made a trailer for my game's beta test!
author: OneMoreFightGame
selftext:
I find it absolutely incredible what Fable 5.2 is capable of.

It's a browser based PvP autobattler where you can create different builds, find loot, and compete in tournaments or a ranked ladder. I'm running a free and open beta test while working on the game and implementing changes. I do plan on making a discord soon.

In regards to how I've used AI to make the game...

I grew up loving a browser async pvp game called MyBrute. It was a lot of fun watching my brute fight and level up, but it got frustrating because there was a lack of control over the brute's development. I figured it would be fun playing a more in depth version of the game with unique loot drops, a ranked ladder, tournaments, and more choice in regards to your build.

I used Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 (and now 5.2) for most of it. I began by telling Claude basically that I had a game idea but had very little experience making games. So I started out by giving it my core foundational ideas and then asking it to help me develop a detailed workflow with consistent check-ins, guidance and direction, and playtesting in order to get it done. We started by having it give me about a 300 page checklist of questions for me to fill out that determined the direction of the game. These included questions about how leveling works, whether to include ranked and tournaments and dungeons, a player run auction market, art style, monetization (if it ever gets there, I want to keep it free to play and zero pay to win), and a lot of other things. 

Then once I was done with that it helped me make a prompt to do in a build chat (that is different than the developmental chat I had been using) and plug it in. Then I playtest, give feedback, list ideas, answer questions, and continue down that path. Right now I'm on version... 75 I think?

Anyways this trailer was made specifically by just asking Fable 5.2 to create something I could easily share with people to hopefully get people to join the beta. For balancing purposes more players = better numbers to run (that are significantly more creative than the thousands of simulations claude will run) and also a better test of systems like the open market, ranked, etc

I didn't know what tag to use for this so let me know if it needs changed. I thought the trailer was honestly really cool that it could put it together so quickly

Have a good day everyone!
